:::{#def-elementwise-function}
#### Elementwise application of a function to a vector

Let $f : A \to B$ be a function ([definition](#def-function)),
and let $\vx = \pt{x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n}$ be a vector whose entries all lie in $A$.
The **elementwise application** of $f$ to $\vx$,
written $f^{\odot}(\vx)$,
is the vector of the values of $f$ at the entries of $\vx$:

$$
f^{\odot}(\vx) = \pt{f(x_1), f(x_2), \ldots, f(x_n)}.
$$

It is a function $f^{\odot} : A^n \to B^n$,
where $A^n$ is the $n$-fold Cartesian product of $A$ with itself ([definition](sets.qmd#def-cartesian-product)).

:::
